accepted_protocol.fresh_classifier_requirement: Fine-tune a fresh classifier initialized from pinned public CLIP on classifier-fit only.

actual_production_classifier_behavior.reason: fit_classifier_images_with_role_access passes config.optimizer and config.epochs from the confidence-oriented ResearchRunConfig directly to fresh classifier fitting.

critical_scientific_decision.assessment: The accepted protocol freezes the confidence schedule but does not choose a fresh-classifier schedule. Current production silently applies that confidence schedule to the classifier and materially differs from the only accepted legacy Stage-1 RSNA ViT-B/32 schedule. This is not scientifically authorized merely because the code validates it.
minimal_proposed_remedy: Before real fitting, amend/freeze the accepted protocol with an explicit fresh-classifier optimizer, batch size, epoch budget, seed, augmentation, precision, and checkpoint-selection budget.

After that decision, make the production classifier path consume a separately named immutable classifier schedule while leaving the confidence schedule unchanged; add focused RED/GREEN tests that classifier and confidence settings cannot be conflated.
Do not start real fitting or silently select either the legacy or current schedule before that decision.
